description: A number is inherited as a number, so a larger font gets taller lines (1.5 x 32px), while a length is inherited as the same pixels whatever the font size.

florui.css: .p { width: 240px; line-height: 1.5; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; } .big { font-size: 32px; background-color: #c9d6ff; } .fixed { line-height: 30px; background-color: #ffe9c9; } .huge { font-size: 32px; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chrome 155 on Windows: 2.93% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. With the property ignored the same fixture measures 12.1% and the box is 6.9px too tall, so it fails.
